_설명: 천일문 2권 워크북 Chapter 05 to부정사의 Chapter Test 가운데 too ~ to / enough to / in order to 문항을 변형한 것. 기본 4과 부정사[2] 자리에 합쳐 둔다.

questions.prompt: 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰세요.
body: Jinho was so tired that he couldn’t finish his homework.

questions.prompt: 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰세요.
body: She was so brave that she could speak in front of everyone.
→ She was ________ ________ ________ ________ in front of everyone.

questions.prompt: 짝지어진 두 문장의 의미가 다른 것을 고르세요.

choices.text: My mom told me where to go first. = My mom told me where I should go first.
She was too tired to walk anymore. = She was so tired that she couldn’t walk anymore.
I am too nervous to eat right now. = I am so nervous that I can’t eat right now.
He visited Gyeongju to see the old temples. = He visited Gyeongju in order to see the old temples.
Mia is tall enough to touch the ceiling. = Mia is so tall that she can’t touch the ceiling.

questions.prompt: 다음은 학생들의 새해 목표입니다. 이를 보고 <조건>에 맞게 문장을 완성하세요.
body: 진수 — do not stay up late / keep his health
미나 — read many books / widen her knowledge
questions.answer: (1) stay up late in order to keep his health  (2) read many books in order to widen her knowledge
